description: Implement draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-06 + RFC 8984 §5.2 data types. Types only — no async. Structs: TaskList (id, name, description, color, sortOrder, isSubscribed, shareWith, myRights, isVisible, role), TaskRights (boolean flags), TaskListRole enum (Inbox/Trash/Other), Task (full JSCalendar Task with JMAP additions: id, taskListId, isDraft, workflowStatus, checklists, comments, estimatedWork, impact, plus all JSCalendar common fields; complex sub-objects as serde_json::Value where spec is insufficiently stable), TaskNotification, TaskFilterCondition, TasksCapability, TasksAccountCapability. Note: draft expired 2023 — use best judgement on stub fields. Spec: draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-06 + RFC 8984 §5.2. Pattern: jmap-mail-types.
title: jmap-tasks-types: JMAP Tasks data types
